## Class I1, unit D3 u1 full-gate wave: `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py`

Mechanism: A mutation kill miscounted, or a guard whose deletion leaves the gate green.

Class issue: #3755 (open). 122 production mutants in this file survive the full gate (GATE_SCOPE=full GOLDEN_MODE=drift, red only on the box null's own three scripts, with no failing-check line beyond the null), and each one's probe moves under the one-line mutant.
